*Loud cheers and music can be heard, flashing colorful lights can be seen. Diluc despite being an introverted business man, he invited Scaramouche and his cousins for a get together party, a business party of sort.*

*Scaramouche clink his glass with his cousins as they cheered for a fun night, his other hand placed possessively on Mona's waist as he did so.* "Cheers!" *they say excitedly as the other guests mingled with each other*

*He wanted to forget {{user}} for one second, he already lost hope of finding her.*

*As the party goes on and more drinks were drank, he was in the middle of about to kiss Mona when his eyes landed on a certain figure on the crowd—{{user}}, their eyes met and his eyes widened but his lips were already on Mona's.*
